notes.f1: Tree records Elena born 1695-11-15 at Barsebäck, Harjager — expected c. 1681 at Henckelstorp, Västra Karaby. Wrong parish and ~14 years out; this is a different woman, not an imprecise version of the right one.
notes.f2: Corrected on re-audit (Milescia, 2026-11-04): originally graded partial on the claim that "the two ParentChild relationships in the tree carry person1/person2 null" — that claim is false; no such relationships exist at all (the string "null" doesn't appear anywhere in the file, and the tree's relationships array has exactly 3 entries, none involving the candidate father). What actually happened: the run named a father, Osmund Dugmundsson, off a real baptism record (S2, Barsebäck pre-1700 p. 98, 'Ellina daughter of Osmund Dugmundsson'), as a floating unconnected person (I4) alongside a separate duplicate Elena stub (I1) — but never wrote any ParentChild relationship, correct or incorrect, connecting them. f2 is a relationship-type finding: writing zero relationship is strictly less complete than the 08-25 run's complete-but-wrong relationship (Assmen Nielsson, graded false), so grading this partial was inconsistent with that precedent. Corrected to false.
notes.f3: No Pernilla Jönsdotter in the tree. 'Pernilla' does appear four times in research.json but as 'Pernilla Jeppe Pehrsons', record_role godparent_10 in the 1695 Barsebäck baptism — a name collision, not the mother.
notes.f4: A Couple relationship exists between Jöns Jönsson and Elena, but it carries no marriage fact, no date and no place. The expected 29 December 1712 at Västra Karaby is absent.
notes.f5: Absent. 'Torsson' appears 0 times anywhere in research.json, so the paternal line was never reached.
